prospects.thesis: LMT tops the screen with strong momentum (+15.9% 1M) at a still-reasonable 1.7x P/S, making it the highest-conviction large-cap defense prime. Elevated geopolitical spending, F-35 sustainment tailwinds, and expanding hypersonics/missile defense backlogs support multi-year revenue visibility. Bullish options flow plus institutional accumulation confirm smart money is positioning ahead of continued DoD budget expansion.

AVAV is the pure-play unmanned systems / loitering munitions leader (Switchblade, Puma) — a distinct sub-niche from the primes and directly leveraged to the drone warfare paradigm shift seen in Ukraine and the Red Sea. At a $7.8B cap with +10.4% momentum, it offers small-cap torque with bullish options and institutional flow. Continued Ukraine aid packages and Replicator program allocations are near-term catalysts.

LDOS represents the defense IT services sub-niche — cheaper valuation (0.8x P/S) and different revenue profile than hardware primes, with growing exposure to classified AI/cyber programs for intelligence agencies. Strong +14.0% momentum with bullish options and institutional backing suggests the market is re-rating government tech services. Recent contract wins in digital modernization provide fundamental support.

PATH provides essential theme diversification as the only high-scoring AI/ML name on the screen, offering enterprise automation exposure at a reasonable 3.6x P/S versus richly-valued AI peers. Bullish options and institutional flow suggest positioning ahead of an inflection as agentic AI adoption drives RPA platform demand. Small-cap size ($6B) offers asymmetric upside if enterprise AI budgets accelerate.

SMCI provides critical semiconductor/AI infrastructure theme diversification as the leading AI server OEM, trading at just 0.6x P/S after a governance-driven derating — an attractive risk/reward if compliance overhang resolves. Bullish options and institutional flow with muted +2.3% momentum suggest smart money is accumulating before a re-rating. Blackwell ramp and hyperscaler capex cycle are direct catalysts.
